P_s1.explanation: The unit responds to dense, fine-grained, high-contrast small markings regardless of colour: dial tick marks and numerals on gauges, watches and stopwatches, digit displays, keypads, crossword grids and arrays of lamps. A related but distinct extension is the dark eye region of primate and lemur faces, which is in fact the single strongest activation.
